title: A line that starts with a percent sign inside a top-level block scalar is content, also before a following document
notes: The literal scalar of the first document has no indentation (it may be at indentation 0 in a top-level document, n = -1), and its content lines are `foo` and `%bar`. A line is content of a block scalar until the document markers or less indentation end it, so `%bar` is not a directive (a directive can only follow `...` or start the stream). `---` ends the scalar and starts the second document, `x`. The first value is `foo` and a line break, `%bar` and a line break.

provenance.reference: A reader that ended the block scalar at a line starting with a percent sign.
